notes.title: Intralism: Rebuild is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41483485/58e2cb9d39178bea02ab4f9cb935028f158d8a1a.png[/img]

Greetings friends! It's [b]Oxy949 [/b]with some announcements! [b]Intralism: Rebuild[/b] (new improved version of the game) comes to Steam Store today! Join now to test the new features and support the development!

[h2]Main differences with the original game:[/h2]
[list][*] Greatly improved performance and stability
[*] Multiplayer up to 100 player per room, new coop mode
[*] Improved graphics and visuals
[*] New map events (such as video)
[*] New editor (planned)
[*] Free-To-Play (planned)
[/list]

[h1]More info:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1810700/Intralism_Rebuild/

[h1]Top Q&A[/h1]
[h3]What will happen with the original game?[/h3]
“Nothing. It will stays the same.”

[h3]Will my items transfer to Rebuild?[/h3]
“No. Rebuild is a different game with it's own inventory but when the game will be finished you'll receive some gift”

[h3]Where all the maps?[/h3]
“Correctly Steam has limitation for the Workshop. Our team developed a migration tool. It will upload all your maps from old Intralism to Intralism: Rebuild workshop.”

[h3]Why Early Access?[/h3]
“Intralism: Rebuild is not just a redesign of the original game, it is a completely new version with many differences. Migrating all the old stuff requires time but more important - testing and feedback from players. The game development is not finished yet. Buy it only if you want to support the game development and playtest new features.”

[h3]Approximately how long will this game be in Early Access?[/h3]
“Until major features such as multiplayer and maps editor are added and tested. Roughly 6 months.”

[h3]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/h3]
“Free-to-play, stable multiplayer and new ranks system.”

[h3]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/h3]
“Gameplay is almost finished but the game is missing some features like ranking and maps editor. Multiplayer needs more testing.”

[h3]Will the game be priced differently during and after Early Access?[/h3]
“After Early Access the game will become Free-To-Play. All current purchases are fundraising for the development of the game.”

[h1]Have fun![/h1]

notes.title: Map Moderation Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26478329/7e691665211a2d30b27cb1f2bf7d2c3027449efc.png[/img]

Lately the moderation team has undergone many changes so that we can continue to publish official maps. This announcement will cover the most important changers to all you mappers out there!

The old moderation system has been replaced! This means you will no longer receive a "pending status" in the form of p3/p2/p1 etc. Instead you will receive one of the many status's on our "Moderation Process" document which is listed below! This form lists all the various states your map could potentially go through whilst it is being moderated. The process of how maps are moderated is also available on this form.

Ranking Criteria for maps has also been changed! The general rules remain the same however quite a few new additions have been made. The "Ranking Criteria" document list's the minimum requirements your map needs in order to be eligible for Official! (This document is also available below)

Lastly, this is the most important change to the moderation system. [b]We will not moderate every map anymore, instead we will moderate maps submitted by mappers through a form.[/b] If you're a mapper and you want to have your map moderated you will need to fill out a simple form to notify our mod team. This form is listed below! You can also submit using our discord bot in the [url=https://discord.gg/intralism]official discord server[/url].

All of this may seem very vague or confusing so if you have any questions feel free to ask below or contact a moderator. All of these changes are likely to be updated/changed in the near future, for now this is a trial to see how well this new system will operate!

Greetings friends! It's [b]Oxy949[/b] with new community contest for our game!

[h1][b]Intralism Mascot Challenge 2019:[/b][/h1]
There been a while from Intralism's release and we finally decided that the game needs a mascot!

[h1][b]The Task:[/b][/h1]
Create a cute [b]mascot-character[/b] for Intralism
• Use game's logo as source of inspiration (colors etc)
• Try to keep Sci-fi/future/space theme
• Yours original character only (don't use other's work or existing characters)
• Needs at least 1 image .jpg or .png format, Full HD (1920x1080px) and higher, at least one transparent image (no background) or PSD source in item's content folder (see more info below)

Submit your character to the Intralism Workshop via [b]"Intralism Mascot Challenge 2019 Uploader"[/b] until [b]July 15th 12PM EST[/b]

[h1][b]How to use Intralism Mascot Challenge 2019 Uploader:[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/e57b7271226931316159e86113fad3c66e6b0aa8.png[/img]

To launch: Open Steam -> Library Tab -> Right click on "Intralism" -> Launch "Intralism Mascot Challenge 2019 Uploader" [Uploader works only on Windows].


Fill all the fields, copy your images to content folder (opens via "OPEN FOLDER" button) and press "SUBMIT" button. 

[b][b]IMPORTANT! After successful submission open item's page to fill payment options - it will let you to receive votes.[/b][/b]


[h1][b]The winner will be chosen by community votes + our team and will get:[/b][/h1]
• [b]"Intralism Artist"[/b] role on our official Discord server and website [khb-soft.ru] 
• Nickname + Artist role in [b]the game credits[/b].
• 3 Intralism keys
• 5 epic items + [b]1 unique[/b]
• Possibility to [b]work with us[/b] in future

[i]Please, note that after winning you should agree to transfer us all permissions to your work and that it will officially belong to KHB-Soft.[/i]

[h1][b]Good luck![/b][/h1]

notes.title: About Updates #1. Ranks and Official Maps
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/eea21b712539eab1f045d4a4b4f9660bb9ff3bcc.png[/img]

[b]Hello there dear players! It is time to tell you about global ranks and official maps! :)[/b]

[h1]
[b]About ranks in short:[/b][/h1]

[b]●[/b] You can get a rank by playing only [b]Official maps.[/b] 
You won't get the rank by playing Loved, Funny or Workshop maps.

[b]●[/b] You can get a rank by playing only [b]Normal game mode.[/b]

[b]●[/b] If you haven't got any rank yet your nickname will look like: [b]Nickname#TBD[/b]

[b]●[/b] Once you get the rank you will see your global position near the nickname:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/7240b3286554b9cfb5e341a85ff2df90e0fb7659.png[/img] 

[b]● You can check all Global ranks on our[/b] [url=https://intralism.khb-soft.ru/?page=ranks][b]website[/b][/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/c171249eafe28d53adc1075d85b2510078314c5b.png[/img]

Our website gets the information about profiles from Steam, so you can easily find other players by their Steam nicknames.


[h1][b]Want to increase the rank? :) Read about ranks in detail:[/b][/h1]

[b]●[/b] Each Official map has an own score limit. To get the maximal score you need to hit each arc exactly to the crosshair. Like this:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/89f4427347a64986d316928227e748622243dcfa.png[/img]

When you make a perfect hit like this you will hear a special Hi-Hat hitsound.

● If you didn't hit the crossair well, but was very near to it you will also hear Hi-Hat sound, but won't get the high score. However, you will be able to save your combo.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/dcb15acdc268e4daa071ca7c3896ad47278b9a13.png[/img]

That means you get combo only for Perfect and Good hits.

● If you will make any hit earlier or too late you will lose the combo and get a negative score. You will also hear the different hitsound.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/d4fc5b5663253468140e89d886e11cdd4be37cef.png[/img] 

If you hit the wrong direction or make random clicks your combo will reset and you also lose points. You will hear the glass break hitsound.

● When you finish the map you will see Accuracy and Score amounts. The highter accuracy you have, the highter score you get :) To get the best Accuracy you always need to make Perfect hits.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/6931cdb9e45469f7ccf4a2f906de0d8c00ad24bd.png[/img]

If you will get enough amount of score you will see the Rank Up message on the screen, which will update your position in the Global ranks list.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/4bf341c3cad9672c649923ca4040ac0afa720cc1.jpg[/img]

● Let's summarize: to get the hightest rank you need to play Official maps with the best Accuracy. Good luck with beating ranks!

[h1]Useful tips and settings:[/h1]

● If you don't like hitsounds, you can disable them!
Go to Settings>Audio>Unmark Hitsounds in Normal and Hitsounds in Relax.

● You can also change hitsounds to your own ones. 
1. Open this folder: C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Intralism\Data\Skins\default\sounds 
2. Find the sounds you like, convert them to .wav format and give the same names as in the Intralism folder.
3. Copy and paste your sounds to Intralism folder.

You can try to change sounds by using this [url=https://goo.gl/6icTBG]example[/url]

[h1][b]About Official maps[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/0e6e09d0c31144271b90ab09ea70d585c4feb863.png[/img]

● Currently the game has 11 official maps. All those maps have been made by awesome mappers who got the help from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/IntralismTeam]Intralism Team volunteers[/url] to improve their maps and make them perfect.

11 maps is not the final amount! Starting from this update, we will begin adding new official maps!

Intralism Team will moderate and choose best maps from the Workshop to make them official. They will help to fix some major mistakes and then move the map to the official list.

This was only the first article about new updates. Follow our further news to know more!

Also feel free to join Intralism Official Discord server: https://discord.gg/intralism
There you can ask questions about the game, be aware of latest news and changes, find players from your country and more! :)

notes.title: About Intralism Team and Workshop Moderation
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/0da75a0ff4d5e60163f4e2f17e43048bbaaa3ff8.png[/img]

Hello everyone! It's [b]Sharp.Nsk[/b]

Many of you have already noticed the appearance of comments under published maps in the workshop with the words [b]Moderation, Approved / Not Approved[/b]. This means that the map was checked by our team and rated according to certain criteria.

[h1][b]How the moderation process goes[/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/7943ee041c17b08e2374c8e065f93f4d1397ad0c.png[/img]

Your published map is checking by experienced players: Moderators and Testers

During moderation the map gets different statuses: 

[b]APPROVED[/b] - well made map. 
[b]NOT APPROVED[/b] -  the map which was made bad and needs improving.

Also, the map gets ratings based on three criteria:

[h1][b]DIFFICULTY[/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/668c4147652f7f93d57ec6217543d8cf58d2059e.png[/img]

[b][1 - 2][/b] - Easy
[b][3][/b] - Normal
[b][4 - 5][/b] - Hard

[h1][b]TIMING[/b][/h1] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/4f5bf51b9ec0d857de9cab628338b59561b8b191.png[/img]

Arcs placement, getting into the rhythm, variety - all mapping in general. 
At the moment, the minimum rating is [b][3][/b], the maximum one is [b][4,5][/b]
 
[h1][b]STORYBOARD [background/special effects etc][/b][/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/c9223be64402970deb3f87f4f800215518b5c4b6.png[/img]

[b][1][/b] - No background [black/gray one]
[b][2][/b] - 1 background or a few different colors
[b][3][/b] - 1 background/different colors + camera movement
[b][4][/b] - A few backgrounds or colors with or without camera movement, a good idea
[b][5][/b] - A few backgrounds, camera movement, special effects, a good idea - the storyboard looks really perfect.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/c8824814729bc6b4bd8f94a369141e8b933069f3.png[/img]

At the moment, each workshop map has its own rating [except recently published maps] and we continue to check them :)

All maps are sorted by collections, you can view them in this discussion: http://steamcommunity.com/app/513510/discussions/1/1369506834142229553/

Some of your maps can be hidden from the workshop if they were made very bad. Therefore, our team asks you very much to make efforts while creating a map.

However, if your map was hidden - it can be remade and improved. 

If you encounter difficulties, we are always ready to help you with improving of maps. To get help, you need to join our special server in Discord, dedicated to mapping in Intralism: https://discord.gg/jjxq2qc


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/0e6e09d0c31144271b90ab09ea70d585c4feb863.png[/img]

After the long moderation we selected 15 maps which will become official after the update of the game. Official maps will be visible to players in the game menu in the first place and divided by difficulty. 
You will know more information later :)


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/8149c7db1e385be5db5bc75e5b49234b8efe5b66.png[/img]

And finally, I want to introduce our team to you!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/oxy949] [b]Oxy949[/b] [/url] - Main Developer and Creator of the game

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/caxp] [b]caxapexac[/b] [/url] - Developer, Global Moderator

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198145523055] [b]Sharp.Nsk[/b] [/url] - Developer, Global Moderator


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/93bc1ebd3f03f901e4465dd0e0fcdac96511593d.png[/img]

Those who can leave comments with ratings under your map [as well as Global Moderators]:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/AK_FrostBite] [b]Frostbite[/b] [/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Meltdown16] [b]MeltDown[/b] [/url]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/3f59c6a1535bd59c40778bfe9fe06a2bc3bec98c.png[/img]

Experienced community players who help Moderators and work with them. As they gain experience in moderation, they can become Moderators too:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198063828954] [b]Laserstormelpies[/b] [/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/senasmrt] [b]SenaSmrt[/b] [/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/nlolicon] [b]nlolicon[/b] [/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Nentse] [b]Nentse[/b] [/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/Zemqu] [b]Zemqu[/b] [/url]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/9da88467b36416ffc657053cd63b990e1b4666d4.png[/img]

Thank you for attention. More interesting news will come next! :)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/583558bc38872e8fdc56862455a8ac51e278f5c3.png[/img]

Hi all, [b]Oxy949[/b] here.
 [b]"Winter Holidays Event"[/b] now live!
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/331eb160c48cb6382d21f9c6a7c73603d8b6d109.png[/img]
We added three new winter maps to the "Arcade". Completing each will result a reward:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/97d4cfa093b528e9350f87acef89cee495fae54b.png[/img]
Rewards are tradable, but not craftable.

Event will last until [b]January 15th 12PM EST[/b], so hurry up!
Have fun! Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

Now, I want to say "Thanks" to the all maps authors! All, who has submitted a map will receive a unique item reward [url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/fbd168835f16f6e6d7c945f099af6c5d3a524d37.png]Green Lollipop[/url]

And the winners are:
1. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=818653710]Last Christmas[/url] by [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/caxapexac]caxapexac[/url]
2. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=818812586]Sauniks - Carol Of the Bells[/url] by [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/AK_FrostBite]Frostbite[/url]
and
3. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=818589470]How to rock?– Christmas[/url] by [url=http://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561198156799654]Argonaft[/url]

Congratulations! They will receive a golden version of the "Lollipop" Item:
[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/0d98903996ef72890efb5d3c252e715c363e1f39.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26478329/64ccb2d0320772c0b155733d535cf2c9eea58ba3.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Update 2.0:[/h1]
[b]• Winter Holidays Event[/b]
[b]• Added Russian language[/b]
Can be selected in the game properties in Steam Library
[b]• Images on maps is now cover full screen[/b]
[b]• After playing a map, player will return to the maps list[/b]
[b]• Some fixes[/b]

As usual, if you find a bug, please let us know about it [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/513510/discussions/0/]here[/url]

notes.title: Update 1.9
notes.content:
Hi all, it's [b]Oxy949[/b]!
New update with crafting and some fixes.
[img=http://khb-soft.ru/uploads/Intralism/intralism_1.9_1.png][/img]
[b]• Added 3 new items, useful for crafting[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.7
notes.content:
Hi all, Oxy949 here.
New major update! There are a lot of changes:
[img=http://khb-soft.ru/uploads/Intralism/intralism_1.7_1.png][/img]
[b]• Added items outline[/b]
[b]• Added  crosshair with settings[/b]
"Crosshair" indicate correct position for notes
[b]• New "hardcore" mod[/b]
Comes with it's own leaderboards. In the hardcore there are no checkpoints, only 1 life and penalty for premature or delayed pressing

[b]• Reworked interface:[/b]
[img=http://khb-soft.ru/uploads/Intralism/intralism_1.7_2.png][/img]
Game over screen now have map info

[b]• Added maps list:[/b]
[img=http://khb-soft.ru/uploads/Intralism/intralism_1.7_3.png][/img]
Contains 4 groups: featured, new, trend, most voted

[b]• Two hands support[/b]
Two hands maps can be created in the level editor (there are new option and new environment (#6) in the level config). By default, left circle control is as normal (W-A-S-D or Arrows) and right circle controlled by I-J-K-L or NUM5-NUM1-NUM2-NUM3. We're still working on this and ready for [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/513510/discussions/]discussions[/url]

[b]• Added input settings[/b]
[b]• Added colors in a leaderboards[/b]
[b]• Workshop maps now have a "more info" and "Workshop" button[/b]
[b]• Back to lobby from multiplayer[/b]
[b]• Changed FOV from 37 to 50[/b]
[b]• Spectators can now leave with ESC[/b]

[b]• Fix for XP from maps[/b]
[b]• Auto-subscribtion to created map[/b]
[b]• Editor: fix for updating img/ogg[/b]
[b]• Fix for locale[/b]
[b]• Fix for achievement #20[/b]
[b]• Some other bug fixes[/b]

notes.title: Update 1.6 + Update 1.6.1
notes.content:
Hi all, Oxy949 here! 
In this update we have some interesting stuff for you. So let's begin!

• Renamed "levels" to "maps"
• Improved list of maps (in the game):
[img=http://khb-soft.ru/uploads/Intralism/intralism_1.6_1.png][/img]
Now players can easily add/remove maps to the favorite list. Favorite maps displayed before other. Added "unsubscribe" button. "More Info" button in the map description now leads to the workshop page (if "more info url" parameter not set by creator of the map)

• Added option to the settings to change bloom shader brightness:
[img=http://khb-soft.ru/uploads/Intralism/intralism_1.6_2.png][/img]
We received a lot of response from you to add an option to change "brightness" of the game. Here it is!

• Renamed "Enable Shaders" toggle to "Anti-Aliasing" toggle
• Added -help as start parameter to enable a diagnostic menu
• Improved security of the workshop maps
• Fixed negative and null level bug
• Fixed "map preview" option not working
• Some other bug fixes

Update 1.6.1:
• Improved "game over" screen. Now shows used checkpoints count
• Fixed negative and null level bug (again)
• Renamed "Level Preview" toggle to "Map Preview" toggle
